fields.Name: T319 - Scheduling Activity History and Row Detail
fields.Description: Exercises SchedulingActivityComponent's custom execution-history table with expandable ToggleExpand detail rows and the trends chart — a hand-built table, not the generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and switch to the 'Scheduling' application, then open its 'Activity' left-nav section. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. The Activity view shows an 'Execution History' table (Status, Job Name, Started, Duration, Error columns) and typically job-type summary cards and an 'Execution Trends' bar chart above it. Click an execution ROW to EXPAND it and verify a detail area opens inline showing fields like Started/Completed/Duration/Status and 'Open Run Record' / 'Open Job' buttons. Success is the history table rendering AND a row expanding to reveal its detail. If there are no executions, seeing the 'No executions found' empty state is acceptable.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Activity section renders an Execution History table (and/or trends chart / job-type summary cards), or a valid 'No executions found' empty-state
Clicking an execution row expands an inline detail panel with Started/Completed/Status fields and Open Run Record / Open Job buttons (when rows exist)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
